title: 橡树资本马克斯：美联储少说话，市场反而更安全？
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: Well, I actually think that less communication is better.
segments.zh: 其实我认为，少一些沟通反而更好。

segments.en: I'm not looking for the Fed Chair to tell me what to do, or even tell me what he's going to do.
segments.zh: 我并不指望美联储主席告诉我该怎么做，甚至不指望他告诉我他打算做什么。

segments.en: But I think that to the extent that the central banker tells people less about what he's going to do,
segments.zh: 但我认为，央行官员越少透露他打算做什么，

segments.en: they have to make their portfolios and their businesses anti-fragile, which is better for society.
segments.zh: 人们就越需要让自己的组合和业务具备抗脆弱性，这对社会更有利。

segments.en: When everybody in society thinks they know exactly what the Fed's going to do and prepares for that,
segments.zh: 当社会中的每个人都以为自己确切知道美联储会怎么做并据此准备时，

segments.en: then the society is dependent on that outcome. And if something else happens, then bad things can happen.
segments.zh: 整个社会就会依赖那个结果。一旦出现别的情况，就可能发生糟糕的事情。

segments.en: So I think it reads, I think it adds to safety in the environment overall.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这总体上增加了环境的安全性。
